incident-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xx and p99 latency for model variant 'v3-experimental' in us-west-2. >40% error rate on a subset of customer keys. Auto-escalation: paging Sophie (on-call).
Sophie (on-call): I'm on it. seeing repeated KV cache thrash and OOM-ish traces. pulling logs + sessions. @Devon please stand by for rollback/route changes.
Devon: on it. initial look: spike concentrated to key=prod-42 and a long-running batch job. qps doubled for that key.
Sophie (on-call): per runbook "variant-failover": plan = (1) emergency-slice heavy keys, (2) demote v3-experimental -> weight 0, (3) route to v2-stable, (4) monitor and notify CS. execute in that order.
Devon: applying emergency quota slice for prod-42 now:
```bash
redwoodctl quotas update --key prod-42 --slice 15
# returns 200 OK
```
ops-runbook-bot: Quota update applied for prod-42 -> slice=15%. Metric note: key_prod-42_qps -38% within 20s.
Maria: pinging Customer Success to prep outbound for impacted customers, will include ETA and mitigation steps. @Customer Success
Customer Success: got it, drafting messaging for the 12 affected accounts. flagging highest-visibility customers for immediate call.
Devon: next step: demote v3-experimental weight to 0 and pin traffic to v2-stable. running safe CLI sequence now:
```bash
# demote risky variant, promote stable
redwoodctl variants set-weight --model chat-llm --variant v3-experimental --weight 0 \
  && redwoodctl variants set-weight --model chat-llm --variant v2-stable --weight 100
```
Devon: command completed. control-plane responded 202 -> rollout in progress.
Sophie (on-call): Confirming: all incoming traffic should now route to v2-stable. watch p50/p95/p99 + errors.
Devon: health checks green for v2-stable. errors dropped from 42% -> 2.1% in last 30s. p99 latency from 1.6s -> 0.48s. :white_check_mark:
Liam: creating incident tracking ticket with mitigation notes. tagging eng-runtime for postmortem.
Maria: CS update sent to impacted list with mitigation and next steps. one customer asked for ETA on canary re-enable.
Sophie (on-call): We'll keep v3-experimental weight at 0 and block redeploys for 30m. After cooldown, run a controlled canary: 1% traffic + synthetic validation. If stable, perform progressive ramp.
Devon: leaving a temporary guard in infra to auto-circuit any variant that exceeds 5% errors in 60s. rule added.
ops-runbook-bot: Circuit rule added: variant_error_threshold=5%, window=60s -> auto-demote weight 0.
Sophie (on-call): Thanks team. assigning follow-ups: Devon -> postmortem draft, Maria -> CS follow-up, Liam -> incident ticket owner. Handing off to eng-runtime for RCA work.
Customer Success: monitoring replies, will escalate any urgent customer P1s to the incident channel.
incident-bot: Incident mitigation applied: v3-experimental demoted and traffic routed to v2-stable. Continue to monitor.
Sophie (on-call): marking this thread for resolution after 30m if metrics stable. :thumbsup:
Devon: I'm going to snapshot logs and KV traces and attach to INC-2964001234.
Liam: INC-2964001234 created. Status=mitigated, severity=sev2.
Sophie (on-call): Closing pager for now. Oncall handoff in 25m to next shift for follow-up.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: mitigation successful, no ongoing user-impacting errors.
